summary.name: Folx
summary.one_liner: Folx is a Mac download manager that splits downloads into threads, organizes and tags files, and handles torrents.
use_cases: Speed up large file downloads on a Mac
Download files through a proxy server
Find downloaded files with Spotlight tags
Download and manage torrents on macOS
summary.what_it_does: Folx is a download manager for macOS that splits downloads into multiple threads and can resume interrupted downloads. It supports browser integration and downloading through a proxy. Files can be tagged, and those tags are searchable through macOS Spotlight. The page also describes a PRO tier that adds smart speed adjustment, download scheduling, a password saver, Music app integration, up to 20 threads per download, and a built-in torrent search tool.
notable: Splits downloads into threads, with up to 20 threads in PRO
Spotlight integration for finding tagged files
Browser integration and proxy download support
caveats: Several features such as scheduling, password saver, and more than two threads are PRO-only
Free version limits downloads to two threads and two saved passwords
Built-in torrent search is listed as a PRO feature
